info.title: LinkedIn Marketing API: Posts, Images, Videos, Organizations (written from the reference pages)
info.description: Written from LinkedIn's Microsoft Learn reference pages at the Marketing September 2026 version (202609); LinkedIn publishes no OpenAPI document. See SOURCE.md.

post.description: The Posts API facilitates the creation and retrieval of organic and sponsored posts. You should get a 201 response and the response header x-restli-id contains the Post ID such as urn:li:share:6844785523593134080 or urn:li:ugcPost:68447855235931240.

get.description: Retrieve all posts for a member or organization. By default, all Posts API finder results are sorted by post last modified time (lastModifiedAt field) in descending order (latest to oldest). Configure this using the optional sortBy param. The default is 10 and maximum allowed count is 100.

parameters.name: Linkedin-Version
parameters.description: All APIs require the request header Linkedin-Version: {Version in YYYYMM format}.

parameters.name: X-Restli-Protocol-Version
parameters.description: All APIs require the request header X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Must be author

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Author of the post (can be either posted from a member or their company page).

parameters.name: viewContext
parameters.description: By default, viewContext is READER, which specifies the version of the post that has been published and is viewable to general audience.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The index of the first item you want results for.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of items you want included on each page of results. There could be fewer items remaining than the value you specify. The default is 10 and maximum allowed count is 100.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: The sort order for the results in descending order. LAST_MODIFIED (for last modified time) or CREATED (for created time).

get.description: To retrieve posts, use URNs such as: ugcPostUrn (urn:li:ugcPost:{id}) or shareUrn (urn:li:share:{id}). By default, viewContext is READER, which specifies the version of the post that has been published and is viewable to a general audience. The AUTHOR viewContext can be used to retrieve the latest version of a post, which has not yet been published; it can be in a number of possible states such as: PUBLISHED, DRAFT or PROCESSING. URNs included in the URL params must be URL encoded.

post.description: Use the initializeUpload action to register the upload. When you initialize, you declare the upcoming upload. Use the upload URL to upload the image. SYNCHRONOUS_UPLOAD is not supported in Images API. The Images API supports the following image pixel count and formats: Images with less than 36,152,320 pixels. JPG, GIF, and PNG formats. GIF format supports up to 250 frames. For images with company URN owners, the caller must have ADMIN or DSC permissions for the company page. For images with member URN owners, the caller must match the image owner.

Error.description: Error responses have the following details: message - A description of the error. serviceErrorCode - A subcode that further classifies the error. status - The type of error (status code).

Distribution.description: Distribution of the post both in LinkedIn and externally

feedDistribution.description: Specifies the feeds distributed to within LinkedIn. NONE-Do not distribute within LinkedIn via feed. MAIN_FEED-Distribute to the flagship feed, and container entity feed if applicable.

targetEntities.description: Intended audience for this post. The target entities targeted for distribution. The distribution is an OR of the targets in the array.

thirdPartyDistributionChannels.description: External distribution channels that this post is distributed to (e.g., Twitter, Tencent, Weibo). Empty array indicates the post is not externally distributed.

id.description: The URN of the media such as image or video.

title.description: The media title (Required field for Documents API).

altText.description: The alternate text for the media. None if empty. Optional.

Content.description: The posted content (if any, e.g., video). Optional content indicates a post with only commentary.

poll.description: Details of Poll content (can only be non-sponsored).

multiImage.description: Details of MultiImage content (can only be non-sponsored).

carousel.description: Details of Carousel content (Can only be sponsored).

celebration.description: Details of Celebration content (can only be non-sponsored and currently, celebration post can't be created through external api).

reference.description: Details of Reference content like event and appreciation.

LifecycleStateInfo.description: Additional information about the lifecycle state for PUBLISH_REQUESTED or PUBLISH_FAILED.

contentStatus.description: Status for post content. If absent, then state doesn't wait for content processing. PENDING, PROCESSING, and FAILED are available values. If processing completes UGC transitions to PUBLISHED and the contentStatus is null.

isEditedByAuthor.description: Indicates whether a post was edited by the author after publishing.

ReshareContext.description: The context in which the post was re-shared - only be set for re-shares.

id.description: Unique ID for the object. Can contain more URN types (in development) ugcPostUrn or shareUrn read-only

author.description: Author of the post (can be either posted as member or their company page).

commentary.description: The user generated commentary for the post. little text

createdAt.description: Time at which the resource was created in milliseconds since epoch.

isReshareDisabledByAuthor.description: Indicates whether resharing of the post has been disabled by the author.

lastModifiedAt.description: Time at which the resource was last modified in milliseconds since epoch.

lifecycleState.description: The state of the content. PUBLISHED is the only accepted field during creation. The following values can be returned in responses: DRAFT - Represents content that's accessible only to the author and is not yet published. PUBLISHED - Represents content that's accessible to all entities. This is the only accepted field during creation. PUBLISH_REQUESTED - Represents content that has been submitted for publishing but is not yet ready for rendering. The content will be published asynchronously once the processing has successfully completed. PUBLISH_FAILED - Represents content that has been submitted for publishing but was not processed. An edit is required in order to re-attempt publishing.

publishedAt.description: The time at which the content was published represented in epoch time.

visibility.description: Visibility restrictions on content. Type of MemberNetworkVisibility with the following values: CONNECTIONS - Represents 1st degree network of owner. PUBLIC - Anyone can view this. LOGGED_IN - Viewable by logged in members only. CONTAINER - Visibility is delegated to the owner of the container entity.

MediaLibraryMetadata.description: Metadata for assets stored in the media library.

Image.description: Image API makes it easier for you to manage image assets and create image ads.

status.description: PROCESSING Asset is processing to generate missing artifacts. PROCESSING_FAILED - Processing failed due to client error such as file size too large, unsupported file format, internal error (e.g., performance issue, database error, network failure), or other issue. AVAILABLE - All of the recipe's required artifacts are ready. The asset is available to be served. WAITING_UPLOAD Waiting for client to upload source file or uploading process to be completed.

owner.description: URN of the entity that owns this asset. Can be a person(urn:li:person:123), or organization(urn:li:organization:123) URN

firstByte.description: First byte (inclusive) in the byte range to upload in this part.

lastByte.description: The last byte (inclusive) in the range to upload in this part.

uploadUrl.description: HTTP upload URL that you'll use to make HTTP PUT request.

id.description: The unique video URN. This field is read only.

status.description: PROCESSING Asset is processing to generate missing artifacts. PROCESSING_FAILED Processing failed due to client error such as file size too large, unsupported file format, internal error (e.g., performance issue, database error, network failure), or other issue. AVAILABLE All of the recipe's required artifacts are ready. The asset is available to be served. WAITING_UPLOAD Waiting for client to upload source file or uploading process to be completed.

processingFailureReason.description: Reason for video processing failure. This field will only be present if video.status is PROCESSING_FAILED.

duration.description: The length of the video in milliseconds.

owner.description: URN of the entity that owns this asset. Can be a person(urn:li:person:123), or organization(urn:li:organization:123) URN

fileSizeBytes.description: File size in bytes. This determines how many parts the video upload will be broken into. Maximum allowed Videos size is 5GB.

uploadUrlsExpireAt.description: Typically URLs expire 30 days from the time an upload is initialized.

uploadInstructions.description: Parts are sorted by non-overlapping byte-range. The first entry is byte range: 0 - 4194303, the next one with 4194304 - 8388607 and so on.

uploadedPartIds.description: IDs for each uploaded video part in the multipart upload. The order needs to be the same as the order of parts in the upload instructions. Callers are should get the IDs as ETags from the response headers when they upload the videos.

Organization.description: Organization URNs are in the format urn:li:organization:{organization id} and represent a LinkedIn Company Page.

role.description: A role defines the privileges that a member has within the organization.

email_verified.description: Indicator that Member's primary email has been verified. Optional

scopes.w_organization_social: Post, comment, and like posts on behalf of an organization.
scopes.r_organization_social: Retrieve organizations' posts, comments, and likes.
scopes.w_member_social: Post, comment, and like posts on behalf of an authenticated member.
scopes.r_member_social: Retrieve posts, comments, and likes on behalf of an authenticated member.
scopes.rw_organization_admin: Manage organizations pages and retrieve reporting data.
scopes.r_organization_admin: Retrieve your organization's pages and their reporting data.
scopes.email: Use the primary email address associated with your LinkedIn account
scopes.rw_ads: Create ads and creatives for a sponsored account
scopes.r_ads: Read an authenticated member's Ad Account.
